_comment: Settings for plan.mjs / apply.mjs / check.mjs. apply.mjs REFUSES to run while any value is the string TODO. WRITTEN, NEVER RUN.
_newPackageNote: Open (owner): the Java group. 'com.example' is a placeholder, so the treatment moves it in the same sweep. Must start with the same dotted form, e.g. a package you own. The last segment need not be the id.
_displayNote: Applied in order, longest first. Display strings are a judgement call (the treatment lists the surfaces as Open: jar file name, repo name, wiki title, README title, creative tab). Run plan.mjs and read the counts before accepting.

configFolder._note: Open: Recommended 'ixoras_horses'. NOT applied by apply.mjs: the folder name lives in 16 Java files and needs the auto-move code from the treatment's piece 2. Listed so plan.mjs can count it.

_excludeNote: wiki/text is generated (re-bake it, do not edit it). intake/ and the session log describe the rename itself and must keep the old names. converter/ and tools/rename/ must keep them too.
